description: Search the saved city catalog by city name or alias before adding a city to a trip. Matches whole names, name prefixes and word starts (not text inside a word), exact matches first. Pass country to limit results to one country. An empty result does not mean the place does not exist: trip_city_add can add a real town or island that is missing from the catalog when you pass city_name and country. Returns stored city IDs and location details. Search results do not add or select a city.

country.description: Optional country name or ISO code (for example CR or Costa Rica) to limit results to that country. Pass it whenever the user named a country.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.

query.description: City name or alias to search; two to 100 characters after trimming.

name: cities_search
title: Search City Catalog
